style: Dark, quiet studio photography for an AI automation and software studio. Photorealistic, shot on a full-frame camera with a 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, real materials (matte black metal, graphite, dark wood, paper). Colour grade: very dark olive-black shadows (#10120d family), soft neutral highlights, and exactly one small vivid lime-green (#c9f31d) light source or reflection that never dominates. Low-key lighting, calm, precise. No people, no faces, no hands, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no screens showing content, no watermarks, no illustration, no CGI look.

images.name: workshop-wall
images.alt: Blank sticky notes in purple, green and yellow on a dark wall after a workshop
images.prompt: A dark charcoal wall in a quiet meeting room after a team workshop, a loose grid of about fifteen completely blank square paper sticky notes in three colours (deep violet, emerald green, golden yellow), slightly curled edges, raking side light from the left, a thin lime-green light strip glowing softly at the far edge of the frame. The notes are entirely blank with no writing.

images.name: handoff-desk
images.alt: A dark desk at night with a closed notebook, a closed laptop and a thin line of lime light
images.prompt: A wide, low-angle view across a matte black desk at night: a closed dark notebook, a closed laptop seen from the side, a ceramic cup, and a thin lime-green LED line reflecting along the desk edge. Large area of deep shadow on the left third for overlaid text. Nothing on any screen.

images.name: patch-cables
images.alt: Close view of neatly routed dark cables joining two pieces of equipment, with one lime status light
images.prompt: Macro photograph of neatly routed matte black cables connecting two pieces of dark anodised equipment, extremely tidy, one tiny lime-green status light glowing, everything else in graphite and black, very shallow depth of field.
